controlCommands.name: create
controlCommands.summary: Use one shell command: `/create`. By default it creates the business, schedules the CEO, and starts one bootstrap turn.

examples.label: Basic
examples.command: /create latexflow "Build a SaaS that helps researchers turn LaTeX notes into polished PDF handouts and study packs."

examples.label: Live mode with wakeups
examples.command: /create --live --schedule "every 6h" latexflow "Build this business end to end."

examples.label: Record only
examples.command: /create --no-auto latexflow "Overleaf competitor for LaTeX power users"

flags.name: --live
flags.description: accepted for compatibility; live is already the default

flags.name: --no-auto
flags.description: create or update only; do not run or auto-schedule the CEO

flags.name: --auto
flags.description: accepted for compatibility; auto-start is already the default

flags.name: --schedule
flags.description: set the CEO wake cadence, for example "every 6h"

flags.name: --archetype
flags.description: business type: saas (default, web product), app (App Store app), shopify (Shopify store). Choices not yet enabled fail closed with archetype_unavailable:<key>.

controlCommands.name: rl
controlCommands.description: Observe the RL loop: status, lessons (approve/reject), why, policy

controlCommands.name: focus
controlCommands.summary: Work focus is per business: marketing-only keeps future CEO turns and crons on demand/research/outreach/conversion work; product-only keeps them on product/app/build/checkout work.

controlCommands.name: wake
controlCommands.description: Wake Hermes CEO for the current business
controlCommands.summary: Wake the current business CEO immediately and ensure its recurring wake cadence. Defaults to every 6h.

controlCommands.name: run
controlCommands.description: Run a CEO instruction for the current business

controlCommands.name: delete
controlCommands.description: Delete the current business after preview
controlCommands.summary: Dry-run by default; with `--confirm` deletes the business database rows, public product surfaces, Cloudflare R2 edge artifacts, Takyon CEO cron jobs, and the business subdomain. By default it also deletes the durable workspace and local cache/files.

flags.name: --confirm
flags.description: permanently delete after showing the same candidates in preview

flags.name: --no-files
flags.description: preserve private workspace/cache files only; public product surfaces are still removed

flags.name: --no-cron
flags.description: leave matching Takyon cron jobs in place

flags.name: --domain
flags.description: also remove an explicit business-owned subdomain under the base domain

controlCommands.name: secret
controlCommands.description: List redacted secret keys or set one

controlCommands.name: credits
controlCommands.description: Buy creative credits or allocate channel budgets
controlCommands.summary: Use `/credits buy <credits>` to create a Stripe checkout, `/credits allocate meta 100` to move existing credits into a channel budget, and `/credits` to inspect balances.

controlCommands.name: gc
controlCommands.description: Garbage collect stale ephemeral Takyon state
